description: Cookbook of Jessie Henning, resident of Sunset, WA. According to her granddaughter, Arlene (Prince) Beale, Pomeroy, WA, Jessie Henning was born in Tennessee, but lived most of her life in Sunset, WA. She was known as a great cook. Arlene can remember her grandmother drying fruit and especially her excellent dried apple cake.
